title: The Creation
verse: In the beginning God created the heaven and the earth.
description: In six days God made the heavens, the earth, and all that is in them.

title: Noah's Ark
verse: But Noah found grace in the eyes of the LORD.
description: A righteous man builds an ark, and God sets His bow in the cloud.

title: David and Goliath
verse: Thou comest to me with a sword, and with a spear, and with a shield: but I come to thee in the name of the LORD of hosts
description: A shepherd boy faces a giant with a sling, a stone, and faith.

title: Daniel in the Lions' Den
verse: Thy God whom thou servest continually, he will deliver thee.
description: Thrown to the lions for praying, Daniel is kept safe by God.

title: Jonah and the Great Fish
verse: Now the LORD had prepared a great fish to swallow up Jonah.
description: Running from God's call, Jonah is swallowed by a great fish.

title: Jesus Calms the Storm
verse: And he arose, and rebuked the wind, and said unto the sea, Peace, be still.
description: With three words, Jesus stills the wind and the waves.

title: The Prodigal Son
verse: I will arise and go to my father
description: A lost son comes home to a father who runs to meet him.

title: The Good Samaritan
verse: But a certain Samaritan, as he journeyed, came where he was: and when he saw him, he had compassion on him
description: Who is my neighbour? A stranger shows mercy on the road.
